changes: Tagged narration is validated and sent in one native model request; maximum 160 spoken characters. Plain narration retains sentence chunking.
Caption text and ASR expected text exclude direction markup.

Internal silence is preserved for tagged speech. Unexpected trailing silence over 2 seconds is rejected before trimming, with at most three attempts. An explicit final pause is preserved. Quiet voiced tails use an adaptive activity floor.
Tagged voice preparation bypasses loudness normalization and preserves the original WAV exactly at speed1. Explicit global speed changes still use atempo only.
Tagged narration uses speech cache version4 and is not automatically rewritten to fit duration.

limitations: These changes fix delivery and rejection of malformed or stalled output; they do not guarantee the model follows every emotional/prosodic tag consistently.
This test verifies ASR content and waveform preservation, not perceptual emotion quality or a newly rendered video.
Existing video ASR checks remain responsible for transcript coverage; a clean early stop cannot always be inferred from waveform activity alone.
The original sampling settings and model checkpoint were retained.
validation_notes: The first test monitor observed the outgoing stopped 0.2.0 container during replacement. Independent checks confirmed the running 0.3.0 image, native-tags-v1 health, and source/embedded/live hashes before accepting results.
